descriptions: This dataset contains 25 audio recordings (13 items) on the subjects of Christianity in the Middle East, Muslim-Christian relations, and human rights.

Audio interviews were conducted in English, German, and Arabic. Metadata and accompanying summary texts are provided in English. Additionally, due to the size of the audio files, the summaries and accompanying recording had to be divided in to three archives and uploaded separately.

data_sources: Interviews were conducted by Cornelis Hulsman, Drs., and unnamed members of the Cairo Foreign Press Association. Summaries and metadata of audio recordings were provided by CIDT interns.
